name: Photon Mapping for RRTE
aliases: Refractive radiative transfer equation-based photon mapping
definition: A two-pass rendering algorithm adapted to solve the integral form of the RRTE using basic radiance to conserve energy in participating media with spatially varying refractive indices.
summary: Photon Mapping for RRTE is a two-pass algorithm that simulates light transport in media with spatially varying refractive indices by computing curved photon trajectories to ensure energy conservation and accurate caustics.
